About this Event

Get ready for a night of spine-tingling beats and dark glamour at BOLLYWEEN, brought to you by Urban Desi! Join us for Raleigh’s premier Bollywood Halloween Party, where the vibrant energy of Bollywood meets the thrilling chills of Halloween.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:Music: Dance the night away to heart-pounding bass and the hottest tracks! The night features exclusive sets by DJ RAKSH x DJ DIMPLE, guaranteeing a high-energy mix of Bollywood bangers to keep the dance floor packed all night.Costume Contest: Bring your A-game and dress to impress (or terrify), because we are handing out Cash Prizes for Best Costumes!
